title: 第23章 羲和女帝的要求第24章 九转星辰诀
content_zh:
;;
没过多久，炼丹室内药香达到了顶峰，炉火渐渐收敛。
三颗通体翠绿的极品青木护脉丹静静地悬浮在丹炉之中，熠熠生辉！
炼丹，成功了！
而且是最完美的品质！
周尘袖袍一挥，将三颗丹药精准地收入玉瓶之中。
他转身看向一旁还有些发愣的秦般若，轻轻一笑：
“秦大小姐，承让了。你的南明离火，确实不凡。”
这话听在秦般若耳中，让她俏脸又是一热，哼了一声扭过头去，但心里却不得不承认，这家伙炼丹的本事确实厉害。
周尘不再多言，拿着玉瓶推开炼丹房的门。
等候在外的方青辞立刻迎了上来，美眸中带着期盼：“周公子，如何？”
周尘将玉瓶递了过去：“幸不辱命。”
方青辞接过玉瓶，拔开瓶塞仔细探查，顿时眼前一亮，脸上绽放出惊喜的笑容：
“极品！果然是极品青木护脉丹！药力纯净磅礴，护脉灵效远超我的预期！”
自己果然没有看错，这周尘的炼丹术，比起天阳郡城中那些成名已久的三品炼丹大师，丝毫不落下风。
她心中更加坚定了要交好周尘，并全力推荐他参加炼丹大会的决心。
“方小姐过奖了。”周尘微微一笑，宠辱不惊。
方青辞小心地收好丹药，对随后走出来的秦般若笑道：
“般若，辛苦你了。有这极品护脉丹，明日我们去落霞山脉寻找那蕴神古树，收取木魄灵韵，把握就大多了！”
忽然。

就在这时，周尘的脑海中，毫无征兆地响起了羲和女帝的声音：
“小子，想办法，从她们手中得到一份木魄灵韵。此物对你大有裨益，先别问为什么，回去再告诉你。”
周尘心中一惊。
这位神秘的羲和女帝一般极少主动开口，一旦开口，必定事关重大。
他压下心中的波澜，面上不动声色，看向方青辞：
“方小姐，明日你们去寻找蕴神古树时，能不能带我一同前去？”
方青辞闻言，微微一怔，有些疑惑：“周公子也对那蕴神古树感兴趣？”
周尘想了想，解释道：
“实不相瞒，我最近正在尝试炼制一种特殊的丹药，其中需要用到一份木魄灵韵作为辅药。”
“刚好你们要去落霞山脉，所以想厚着脸皮向方小姐讨要一份。”
方青辞恍然，原来是为了炼丹。
content_en:
;;
Not long after, the aroma of medicine in the alchemy room reached its peak, and the fire gradually subsided.
Three emerald-green top-quality Aoki Vein Guard Pills are quietly suspended in the pill furnace, shining brightly!
Alchemy, successful!
And it is the most perfect quality!
Zhou Chen waved his sleeves and accurately put the three pills into the jade bottle.
He turned around and looked at Qin Banruo, who was still in a daze, and smiled softly:
"Miss Qin, I accept it. Your Nanming Lihuo is indeed extraordinary."
When Qin Banruo heard these words, her pretty face heated up again. She snorted and turned her head away, but she had to admit in her heart that this guy was really good at making alchemy.
Zhou Chen said no more, took the jade bottle and pushed open the door of the alchemy room.
Fang Qingci, who was waiting outside, immediately came up to him, with expectation in his beautiful eyes: "Master Zhou, how are you?"
Zhou Chen handed over the jade bottle: "Fortunately, I did not disgrace my life."
Fang Qingci took the jade bottle, uncorked it and examined it carefully. His eyes suddenly lit up, and a surprised smile broke out on his face:
"Excellent! It is indeed the best Aoki Pulse Protecting Pill! The medicine is pure and powerful, and the effect of protecting the pulse far exceeds my expectations!"
As expected, he was right. Zhou Chen's alchemy skills were not inferior to those of the long-famous third-level alchemy masters in Tianyang County.
She was even more determined to make good friends with Zhou Chen and fully recommend him to participate in the alchemy conference.
"Thank you, Miss Fang." Zhou Chen smiled slightly, unfazed.
Fang Qingci carefully put away the elixir and smiled at Qin Banruo who came out later:
"Prajna, thank you for your hard work. With this top-quality pulse-protecting pill, tomorrow we will go to the Luoxia Mountains to look for the Yunshen ancient tree and collect the wood soul aura, so we will be more confident!"
Suddenly.
At this moment, Empress Xihe's voice rang out in Zhou Chen's mind without any warning:
"Boy, find a way to get a piece of Mu Po Spirit from them. This thing will be of great benefit to you. Don't ask why yet. I'll tell you when I get back."
Zhou Chen was shocked.
This mysterious Empress Xihe rarely takes the initiative to speak. Once she does, it must be of great importance.
He suppressed the turmoil in his heart, looked at Fang Qingci with a calm expression:
"Miss Fang, when you go to look for the Yunshen Ancient Tree tomorrow, can you take me with you?"
When Fang Qingci heard this, he was slightly startled and a little confused: "Master Zhou is also interested in the Yunshen ancient tree?"
Zhou Chen thought for a while and explained:
"To be honest, I am currently trying to refine a special elixir, which requires the use of a portion of Wood Soul Spirit as an auxiliary medicine."
"You happen to be going to the Luoxia Mountains, so I want to shamelessly ask Miss Fang for a share."
Fang Qingci suddenly realized that it turned out to be for alchemy.
